description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cice_bgrid/rules/transport_flux_divergence_layered.esm at N_I = N_J = 4, NCAT = 2, N_LAYER = 8. Pins the canonical expanded bytes of the 9-region 4-D conservative flux-form layered-tracer divergence D(vqicen*uvel,x) + D(vqicen*vvel,y) with halo-copy closures (the centered edge reconstructions of ice_transport_remap.F90:658-666 and the mass update F90:3586-3590, factored through the transport_flux_divergence_cell stencil; the layer axis is passive - the same edge fluxes/areas apply per layer). The numeric correctness is verified against the per-layer formulation of the stage-2 cice_transport tracer pins.
